title: 2603.09896v1
universal_lens: Spatial intelligence in sports integrates 3D perception, relational reasoning, and metric-level localization through probabilistic model alignment with human benchmarks. Multimodal sport video reasoning through calibrated geometric constraints and entity-aware captioning.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference framework maps model confidence thresholds to posterior distributions over spatial tasks, enabling conformal uncertainty quantification for CourtSI-Bench metrics. Bayesian inference over annotated court and player states using conformal predictive distributions for probabilistic video understanding.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning engine encodes player-object relations via graph-based state transitions, supporting dynamic localization and distance estimation under language-guided constraints. Situationally grounded state transitions driven by player-entity interactions and geometric calibration in basketball video contexts.

primitives.name: Semi-Automatic Scene Reconstruction
primitives.verbatim_quote: Leveraging well-defined court geometry as metric anchors, we develop a semi-automatic data engine to reconstruct sports scenes, enabling scalable curation of CourtSI.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: (X_i, Y_i, Z_i): 3D coordinates of scene elements (meters); C_{ij}: Correspondence between camera corners and court geometry; PnP: Perspective-n-Point solver.
primitives.assumptions: Fixed court geometry, accurate camera calibration, sparse feature correspondences.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Degeneracy when camera pose aligns with planar court structure.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE state-transition for tracking entities through discrete event updates, and to GSI conformal prediction intervals for uncertainty quantification of reconstructed 3D positions.
layer2.telemetry: Mean squared error of 3D landmark projection, reprojection accuracy, temporal consistency metrics.

primitives.name: Spatial Counting & Relational Reasoning
primitives.verbatim_quote: CourtSI contains over 1M QA pairs, organized under a holistic taxonomy that systematically covers spatial counting, distance measurement, localization, and relational reasoning, across representative net sports including badminton, tennis, and table tennis.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: d_{ij}: Euclidean distance between objects i and j (meters); \theta_{ij}: Angular separation (radians); R: Relational predicate.
primitives.assumptions: Euclidean metric space, rigid body assumption for players, point mass approximation for balls.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity at co-location (d_{ij} \rightarrow 0), ambiguity in angular ordering on symmetric courts.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE Markov decision processes where states encode object counts and adjacency matrices, while actions represent rule-based interventions; maps to GSI via Bayesian network factorization of joint spatial distributions.
layer2.telemetry: Precision/recall of relational triples, F1-score on counting queries, consistency with physical rules.

primitives.name: Human-AI Performance Gap
primitives.verbatim_quote: These findings indicate that sports scenarios expose limitations in spatial intelligence capabilities captured by existing benchmarks.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: H: Human performance rate (binary success/failure); A: AI model accuracy (0,1); Gap: Absolute difference in performance.
primitives.assumptions: Shared task difficulty, unbiased evaluation metrics, identical input distribution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Zero gap implies perfect alignment; non-zero gap indicates systematic bias or insufficient training data diversity.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI hypothesis testing framework where H is the null distribution and A is the observed test statistic; maps to GSE reinforcement learning where gap represents policy improvement potential.
layer2.telemetry: Statistical significance of gap via permutation tests, error analysis breakdown by query type, domain shift diagnostics.

primitives.name: Spatial-Aware Commentary Generation
primitives.verbatim_quote: The adapted model also generalizes effectively to CourtSI-Ext, an evaluation set built on a similar but unseen sport, and demonstrates enhanced spatial-aware commentary generation.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C: Commentary string; S: Scene description (3D coordinates, trajectories); T: Temporal context; P: Player/team metadata.
primitives.assumptions: Markovian scene evolution, independent token generation given history, linear utility function for coherence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Mode collapse when conditioning on rare events, incoherence in long-term trajectory predictions.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE sequential decision-making where commentary is a latent signal guiding state transitions; maps to GSI via variational autoencoders encoding spatial distributions into compact representations.
layer2.telemetry: BLEU score for n-gram overlap, METEOR for semantic similarity, user preference surveys for narrative quality.
